### Solomon’s Great Wisdom
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/solomons-great-wisdom
Passage: 1 Kings 3:28
Points:
- Solomon's renown for wisdom rests heavily on his handling of the dispute between the two mothers.
- His discernment originated when he unselfishly asked God for understanding to lead rather than for personal gain.
- The difficult case of the surviving child demonstrated to all Israel that God's wisdom guided Solomon's justice.
- Although Solomon made foolish decisions later in life, God remained faithful to his initial prayer.
- God desires to give wisdom generously to all of His people who ask in faith.

### Bible Pathway - April 22
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-april-22-2013.html
Passage: 1 Kings 3:28
Points:
- Solomon recognized his need for divine help to rule as a just leader over God's people.
- Faced with two women claiming the same living infant, Solomon devised an unconventional test of motherly love.
- The true mother proved her identity by offering to surrender her baby to preserve his life.
- Rather than relying on committees or standard state procedures, Solomon trusted God-given discernment to resolve the crisis.
- Godly wisdom remains an essential gift that directs believers whenever they face difficult life choices.
